evals.prompt: Create a 10-slide pitch deck for a digital transformation proposal targeting a retail client. The deck should follow our branded template.
evals.expected_output: Generates a 10-slide .pptx using pptxgenjs with Ava brand palette, Segoe UI typography, wave decorations, logo on every slide, cover and closing gradient slides, and varied content layouts.

assertions.text: Installs pptxgenjs if not present before generating slides
Uses exactly the Ava Orange color #FF5800 (or #F25830) as the primary color — not a generic blue or custom color
Applies Segoe UI font family for all text elements
Includes logo (logo_white.png or logo_color.png from scripts/) on every slide
Opens with a gradient COVER slide and closes with a CLOSING gradient slide
Includes wave decoration on content slides
Uses varied layout types (not the same layout repeated for every slide)
Adds copyright footer and page numbers to every slide
Runs visual QA with sub-agent before declaring output complete

evals.prompt: Build a quarterly business review presentation, 8 slides, for our leadership team. Mark it as Confidential.
evals.expected_output: Generates an 8-slide QBR deck with Ava branding, confidentiality watermark appended to footer, agenda slide, content slides, and closing slide.

assertions.text: Generates exactly 8 slides (or prompts user to confirm count)
Appends '< Confidential >' to the copyright footer string on every slide
Includes an AGENDA or CONTENTS slide with orange numbered grid layout
Applies the official Ava palette exclusively — no improvised colors
Uses SECTION DIVIDER slides to separate major topics
Applies Segoe UI font with correct weights per hierarchy level
Saves output file to ~/Desktop/Marketing/ or current directory with .pptx extension

evals.prompt: Prepare a 6-slide sales deck for a cloud migration offering. Use a bold executive style with large stats and minimal text.
evals.expected_output: Generates a 6-slide deck emphasizing stat callouts, bold numbers, minimal body text, and premium executive visual treatment using the Ava gradient and typography system.

assertions.text: Uses NUMBERED POINTS or large stat callout layouts for data-heavy slides
Keeps body text minimal — no dense bullet walls
Uses the orange-to-purple gradient on at least the cover and closing slides
Segoe UI Bold is used for large numbers and key headlines
Every slide has logo, tagline, footer, and page number
Visual QA sub-agent inspects for text overflow, low contrast, or missing elements
Output file is deliverable without manual edits

evals.prompt: I need an internal all-hands presentation about our H1 strategy, 12 slides. No confidentiality marking needed.
evals.expected_output: Generates a 12-slide all-hands deck with Ava branding, cover, agenda, content sections, and closing. No confidentiality marker in footer.

assertions.text: Does NOT add confidentiality markers since user did not request them
Generates 12 slides with distinct layout types across the deck
Uses white-background TEXT CONTENT layout for body-heavy slides
Applies wave decoration in lower third on white-background slides
Uses dark-background gradient slides for cover, section dividers, and closing
Reads brand-guidelines.md before generating to validate layout coordinates
Passes quality checklist before delivery (Segoe UI, correct orange, logo present)

evals.prompt: Create a 5-slide executive briefing about AI adoption in financial services. Highly Confidential.
evals.expected_output: Generates a concise 5-slide exec briefing with premium visual treatment, '< Highly Confidential >' in footer, TWO-COLUMN or stat callout layouts, and minimal text.

assertions.text: Appends '< Highly Confidential >' (not just Confidential) to footer on every slide
Generates exactly 5 slides — does not pad with unnecessary slides
Uses executive-appropriate layouts: TWO-COLUMN, NUMBERED POINTS, or FULL-BLEED IMAGE
Applies Ava brand palette exclusively — orange, greys, and white only
Wave decoration and logo present on all content slides
Visual QA sub-agent confirms no text overflow or missing elements
Output file path is provided to the user at the end
